title: IdleOps playbk runbook
description: A playbk automation script (*.idleops.yaml): an ordered list of desktop-automation steps run by the IdleOps `playbk` engine. See https://github.com/andrewiankidd/IdleOps/blob/main/docs/scripting.md

vidcap.description: Record screen video (vidcap) for the whole run while the steps execute.

audcap.description: Record system audio (audcap) for the whole run while the steps execute.

steps.description: Ordered steps, executed top to bottom. A step returning false halts the run.

id.description: Optional identifier. If set on an `exec` step, its process id is available as `%id_pid%` in later `exec` args.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the console while the step runs.

enumDescriptions: Run a command. `args` is the command line; `wait` controls fire-and-forget vs block-until-exit.
Delay. Duration in seconds via `args` or `timeout`.
Poll (waitfr) until a window (and optionally `text`) appears, or `timeout` elapses.
Find `text` in `window` via OCR (txtfnd) and click it (inpctl).
Find `text` in `window` via OCR (txtfnd). Fails the step (halting the run) if absent. Read-only sibling of click-text.
Type `text` into the focused control of `window` (inpctl). Pair with a click-text first if focus is needed.
Capture `window` to the `output` image file (scrcap). Windows only.
Speak `text` via text-to-speech (spkbak); optionally save to `output`, pick a `voice`.
UIA: set the selected element's value to `text` (uiactl). Focus-free; works on WinUI/WPF/UWP/Win32.
UIA: read the selected element's value and fail unless it equals `text` (uiactl).
UIA: invoke the selected element - buttons, menu items (uiactl).
UIA: toggle the selected checkbox / toggle button (uiactl).
UIA: expand the selected menu / combo / tree item (uiactl).
UIA: collapse the selected menu / combo / tree item (uiactl).
UIA: select the selected list item / tab / radio (uiactl).
Hold `text` key(s) down on `window` for `duration` seconds (inpctl). method: foreground|background.

args.description: exec: the command line. sleep: duration in seconds. Also a fallback for sleep/wait-window/screenshot/speak when their dedicated field is omitted.

wait.description: exec only: if true, block until the process exits. Default false (fire and forget).

window.description: Window title pattern (supports `*` wildcards). Used by wait-window, click-text, assert-text, type, screenshot.

text.description: click-text/assert-text: text to find via OCR. type: text to type. speak: text to speak. wait-window: optional text to wait for.

output.description: screenshot: output image path (.png/.jpeg/.bmp). speak: optional output audio path. Relative paths resolve against the run output dir.

image.description: Reference image path for image-based matching (imgfnd).

timeout.description: wait-window: max seconds to wait (default 10). sleep: duration in seconds.

retries.description: Extra attempts after the first failure (Ansible/AzureDevOps style). retries: 2 means up to 3 total attempts. Default 0 (fail fast).

retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts. Default 0. Only meaningful with retries > 0.

continue_on_error.description: If true, a step that still fails after its retries is logged and the run continues instead of halting. Ansible ignore_errors / ADO continueOnError.

background.description: type only: drive the target window via PostMessage without foregrounding it (no focus/cursor steal). Classic Win32 controls only, NOT webviews. Default false (SendInput to the foreground window).

automation_id.description: UIA actions: select the target element by AutomationId (preferred selector). Discover ids with `uiactl -w "..." --dump`.

element.description: UIA actions: select the target element by accessibility Name (e.g. a button label like "Don't save").

control_type.description: UIA actions: select the target element by control type (e.g. Edit, Button, Document, or a numeric UIA id).

duration.description: hold: seconds to hold the key(s) down (must be > 0 in a runbook).

method.description: hold: delivery method. foreground = SendInput (needs focus); background = post to the window (target must process its message queue).

interval.description: hold: ms between re-posts for the background method (default 30).
